patch_description: The seed ansatz uses a linear chain of CZ gates (0-1, 1-2, ..., 6-7) which requires many layers to entangle distant qubits. I replace this with a brick-layer CNOT pattern: first even pairs (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7), then odd pairs (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-0). This creates a ring topology in just one round, enabling full entanglement spread. CNOTs (vs CZ) add asymmetry which can increase expressibility. The rotation structure is RY+RZ before entanglement and RY after, keeping 24 parameters per block (same as seed) but with significantly better entangling capability. This should improve accuracy without increasing overfitting risk.
